The year '''16,100 Before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] ([[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]])''' was a year in the [[Indecta Era]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was notable for the [[Second Siege of Porus Vida]], a battle of the [[Second Alsakan Conflict]].
